# Deviload 2.8.0

**Devil Music stays in the desktop app.** This release keeps the playback engine shipped in 2.7.9 and updates how you browse, organize and listen to music.

- Search as you type, open an artist’s page and load more songs when the catalog provides them.
- Find favorites, history and playlists in the sidebar. Reorder the queue by dragging tracks. Shuffle covers the full list before starting another cycle.
- Keep the same personal recommendations while browsing. Revisit or refresh the page when you want a new selection.
- Open lyrics from the cover or the full player. Words light up individually when word timestamps are available. The player follows lines when the source provides line timings.
- Bring your music from Spotify. Paste a public playlist or album link, or open a Spotify JSON or CSV export. In our large-playlist check we read all 1,476 entries from one playlist link. 1,475 entries had metadata for matching. Select all matches, review uncertain recordings and keep unresolved songs for later.
- Scroll through a large library while only the visible rows are rendered.
- Imported YouTube Mixes reuse track artwork, including mixes already in your library. Playlists show a collage of up to four different covers in the sidebar and playlist header. A custom playlist image takes precedence.
- Add local audio for offline listening and adjust the equalizer in the player.

### Library and discovery

The sidebar brings together Home, Library, Favorites, History, Downloads and playlists. Home shows a time-of-day greeting and a compact seven-day listening summary for this device. Private sessions are excluded. Artist pages can show a previously loaded page or songs from search if the full page is temporarily unavailable.

Add individual audio files or scan a folder without moving the originals. Read embedded tags and covers, rescan after moving files, and use local songs in favorites, playlists, the queue and the mini-player. You can associate a catalog track with your exact local copy so that the recording and timing stay consistent.

### Player, artwork and lyrics

Open the full player from Now Playing or read lyrics beside the library. Immersive mode uses artwork as a backdrop. Animated covers play automatically when available and respect reduced-motion preferences. Static covers remain available for other tracks. Adjust lyric timing per track and return to the current line after scrolling manually.

Artwork loads at a size appropriate for the player or list. Scrolling back to a row can reuse a successful thumbnail choice. Album art in an imported Mix also appears in its track rows, playlist tile and edit preview.

### Sound and playback

Use the six-band equalizer, choose a preset, save your own, or bypass processing. Adjust playback speed for local audio on devices that support pitch preservation. Listening rooms keep normal speed for synchronization. The desktop app uses the established 2.7.9 playback engine.

A temporary buffering notification keeps the current audio connection when the installed engine cannot reopen it or playback has already resumed. This prevents the player from interrupting a recoverable stream.

### Updates

Available updates appear in a prominent notice. On the first launch of an installed update, the app shows the version number and release notes. Reopen them any time from **What's new**.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
